# Coded For You

> Custom-coded websites, web apps, and ongoing digital services built by Kaleb Akulu — no page builders, no templates.

Kaleb Akulu is an 18-year-old self-taught developer who has been building websites since age 14 and taking on real client work since age 16. Coded For You is his freelance web development studio.

## Services

- Web Development — custom-coded sites and apps: /services/web-development
- Video Clipping — long-form content cut into short-form clips: /services/video-clipping
- Social Media Management — content calendars and community engagement: /services/social-media-management
- Lead Generation — funnels and lead capture systems: /services/lead-generation
- SEO Optimization — technical SEO and site speed: /services/seo-optimization
